subject: Finalizing capacity top-up & one-time adjustment for OrbitAnalytics
messages:
From: Sandra Li <sandra.li@orbitanalytics.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Unexpected Q3 overage — need retroactive true-up and itemized invoice

Hi Camila / Marissa,

Hope you both are well. We finished a post-mortem on our Q3 deployment scaling and discovered OrbitAnalytics consumed ~42% more token-hours than anticipated in September after enabling auto-scale. That pushed us past the committed capacity in our agreement for the quarter.

Can you help with a retroactive true-up and an itemized invoice for the additional consumption? Procurement needs line-item detail (token-hours, committed vs actual, unit rate) and an explanation of any one-time charges. I've attached the usage export we pulled from our telemetry.

Attachments: usage_report_q3.csv (CSV, 1.2MB)

Procurement is cc'd on this thread. We're prioritizing getting this settled by the end of next week to close books.

Thanks,
Sandra Li
Head of Cloud Ops
OrbitAnalytics
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sandra Li <sandra.li@orbitanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected Q3 overage — need retroactive true-up and itemized invoice

Sandra — thanks for the export and the heads-up. We dug into the usage file and see the spike tied to the temporary burst pool you used on Sep 14–21. Per your committed plan (Annual Dedicated, 4x GPU pool) we calculate the excess as follows:

- Committed token-hours (Q3): 1,200,000
- Actual token-hours: 1,706,000
- Excess token-hours: 506,000
- Committed rate: $0.0025 per token-hour
- Overage rate (per contract): $0.0035 per token-hour
- Base overage charge: $1,771.00

We propose the following settlement approach to keep things simple and fair:
1) One-time invoice for the measured overage at the contracted overage rate (Invoice total estimate: $1,771).
2) Apply a discretionary operational goodwill credit of $350 to reflect the one-week burst that was necessary for your migration tests.
3) Offer a complimentary 1-week Dedicated capacity top-up (no charge) to cover any near-term migration ripples while you complete scaling adjustments.

Net one-time charge (after credit) would be $1,421. We'll produce an itemized invoice and include the per-day breakdown for the Sep 14–21 window. If that approach works, can Marissa route this through finance and generate the draft invoice? Also, confirm the procurement contact that will pay the invoice (procurement@orbitanalytics.com?).

—Camila
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Sandra Li <sandra.li@orbitanalytics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: Draft invoice (OrbitAnalytics) & billing terms

Team — attaching a draft invoice (INV-20261118-ORBIT-draft.pdf) with the line items Camila outlined: daily excess token-hours and the applied $350 credit. Payment terms are Net 30 from invoice date.

Vivek — looping you in for one-off credit approval (couple hundred dollars). If you approve, I'll mark the invoice as final and send the DocuSign envelope to Sandra / procurement@orbitanalytics.com.

Sandra — please confirm the procurement email and whether invoice should be addressed to OrbitAnalytics legal (billing@orbitanalytics.com) or to procurement@orbitanalytics.com. Also let us know if you require a purchase order number — we can add it to the invoice before finalizing.

Attachments: INV-20261118-ORBIT-draft.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft invoice (OrbitAnalytics) & billing terms

Marissa — approved. The $350 goodwill credit is fine. Proceed to finalize the invoice and send the DocuSign envelope. Please keep the accounting code as STD-OT-2026 so we can track one-time adjustments in the quarter.

—Vivek

Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Draft invoice (OrbitAnalytics) & billing terms

Thanks, Marissa and Camila — that approach works for us. Please address the invoice to OrbitAnalytics, Attn: AP (billing@orbitanalytics.com). Please also include a short narrative on the invoice explaining the 'one-time settlement for Q3 excess token-hours (Sep 14–21)'.

Sandra Li

OrbitAnalytics

Sandra — attached is the finalized invoice and the DocuSign envelope to sign. Per the approved terms: one-time charge $1,771 less $350 goodwill credit = $1,421 (Net 30). Invoice addressed to: OrbitAnalytics, Attn: AP (billing@orbitanalytics.com). Itemized daily breakdown included as page 2.
